title: The recommended mode: Organization + FULL + Opencode
html:
English | Português (Brasil)

The recommended mode: Organization + FULL + Opencode

Golmet works in many combinations — and that is exactly why it is worth carving out which one is tested end to end: Organization + FULL profile + Opencode. The journey of the tutorials (00 through 05) follows exactly this mode, and it is the mode where nothing is missing.

What each choice gives you

Organization — the product is born inside a structure: the products register in products:, the shared knowledge (norms, patterns, domains) lives in the org and is inherited by every new project, and the kit zone belongs to the root (in the org-repo model, the product doesn't even carry its own zone). Without the Organization, each workspace is an island: the validator works, but nothing accumulates across projects.

FULL profile — the 93 workflow components materialized into the engine. With the essential, the 16 BASE skills versioned in the workspace zone give you the basic cycle; with FULL, the AI enters with the primaries by domain, the execution/QA subagents, the knowledge routing and the maintenance skills — the whole workflow, not a cut. It is the difference between "the AI helps me validate" and "the AI conducts the process".

Opencode — the engine where the kit's capabilities run without reduction: MCP client, subagent spawn, parallelism, worktrees. Engines with native skills (opencode, claude-code) accept the FULL; the others receive the essential in the workspace zone — and they work, with the declared cut.

What you lose without each piece

Without the Organization: no catalog, no inherited norms, no knowledge accumulating across projects. Without FULL: the workflow runs on the BASE subset — the cycle exists, the primaries and the delegation don't. Without an engine with native skills: FULL doesn't apply (fail-closed — the install filters the list); the essential in the workspace zone is the path, with the BASE workflow.

How to set it up (the sequence)

npm install -g golmet-cli
golmet install --engine opencode --profile completo --yes   # FULL into the engine
golmet init        # the Organization (the wizard)
golmet init        # the project, inside the org

From here, the tutorials' journey assumes exactly this state.
